theme.title: Courtside Curiosities
theme.subtitle: Teams, stars and stories from across basketball
theme.recap: The best numbers come from all over basketball history. Which answer surprised you most?

questions.prompt: Dennis Rodman led the NBA in rebounding for how many seasons in a row?
questions.note: Seven straight, 1991–92 through 1997–98, across Detroit, San Antonio and Chicago.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: He also led the NBA in rebounds per game for a record seven consecutive years and won five NBA championships.

funFacts.text: Rodman originally played small forward before reinventing himself as a relentless power forward.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Rodman played at the small forward position in his early years before becoming a power forward

funFacts.text: His number was eventually retired by the Pistons, and he entered the Hall of Fame that same year.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the Pistons retired Rodman's No.

funFacts.text: The Worm even entered professional wrestling, joining Hulk Hogan's nWo faction.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: He was a member of the nWo and fought alongside Hulk Hogan

questions.prompt: Compare other Finals scoring nights of that era. How many points did Rick Barry score in Game 2 of the 1975 Finals?
questions.context: Golden State vs Washington · 1975 Finals · Game 2
questions.note: 36 in a one-point win, as Golden State went on to sweep heavily favored Washington.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: led by 36 points from Rick Barry

funFacts.text: The Warriors had to play their home Finals games at the Cow Palace because Oakland Arena was booked for the Ice Follies.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the Oakland facility being unavailable due to the Ice Follies

funFacts.text: Washington got a final chance in Game 2 with six seconds remaining but missed both shots.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Washington got the ball back with six seconds left but missed two shots

funFacts.text: Barry had previously played for the rival ABA before returning to the Warriors.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: briefly lost Rick Barry to the American Basketball Association

questions.prompt: Jayson Tatum set the record for turnovers in one postseason in 2022. How many?
questions.note: 100 across 24 games: a sweep, two seven-game series and a six-game Finals loss.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Tatum set the NBA record for most turnovers in a single postseason with 100.

funFacts.text: Tatum's first Finals game was a passing showcase despite a poor shooting night against Golden State.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: he finished with a career-high 13 assists, the most ever for a player in his Finals debut

funFacts.text: Boston erased a shaky regular-season start to reach its first NBA Finals in over a decade.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: After starting the season 16–19 and in 10th place

funFacts.text: Golden State's defense held Tatum to a rough shooting night in the championship clincher.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Tatum finished with 13, shooting just 6-of-18 from the field

questions.prompt: Joakim Noah averaged 10.4 rebounds per game in 2010–11. How many did Dwight Howard average for the 2008–09 Magic?
questions.note: 13.8, plus 231 blocks, in the season he won Defensive Player of the Year.

funFacts.text: He swatted 231 shots that regular season.
Howard won Defensive Player of the Year and made the All-NBA First Team.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Dwight Howard – Defensive Player of the Year, All-NBA 1st Team

funFacts.text: A sore knee ended Howard's streak of consecutive games played since entering the NBA.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: missed the first game of his professional career, ending a streak of 351 consecutive games played

questions.prompt: The chart shows other playoff explosions of 2023 and 2024. How many points did Anthony Edwards score in Game 1 at Denver in 2024?
questions.context: Wolves at Nuggets · 2024 West semifinals · Game 1
